profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
•	iOS swift developer with over 10 years of experience
•	C++ developer with over 10 years of experience
•	Manager with over 10 years of managing projects and people
•	Couchbase Lite, MongoDB
•	AWS: EC2, SNS, Route 53

positions.title: iOS Architect/Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Menlo Park, California, United States · Remote
positions.description:
Developed and implemented new user interfaces for the ETRADE mobile app. Improved user experience and reduced app crash rate by resolving critical bugs. With one project I implemented a clean design pattern and introduced it to the team. Worked closely with product, design, and backend teams to implement new functionality.
Technologies: Swift, Objective C, SwiftUI, UIKit, Swift Concurrency, Combine
URL: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/e-trade-invest-trade-save/id313259740

positions.title: iOS Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
Spearheaded the end-to-end development of the mission-critical 10b-51 module, ensuring strict adherence to stringent financial regulations and full accessibility compliance.
Orchestrated the successful delivery of high-priority functionality on schedule, effectively managing frequent scope changes and complex stakeholder requirements.
Collaborated closely with product and design teams to translate complex financial workflows into seamless mobile experiences using Swift, UIKit, and Combine.
URL: https://apps.apple/us/app/schwab-mobile/id407358186
positions.insights: Skills: UIKit · Apple Combine · Lean Software Development · Swift (Programming Language)

positions.title: IOS SENIOR SOFTWARE DEVELOPER
positions.description:
•	Design and build advanced internal application for the iOS platform that allows inspection engineers to monitor, diagnose, and service PG&E assets.
•	Collaborate with cross-function teams to define, and ship new features. Unit-test code for robustness. Continuously discover, evaluate, and implement new technologies and new software development using various design patterns.
•	Tools used: iOS, Swift, Xcode, XCT unit tests, AppDynamics, Bitrise, Cocoapods, GitHub, JIRA

positions.title: Software Consultant
positions.description:
• Created custom internal iOS device maintenance tool for iPad that allows our system engineers to monitor, diagnose, and replace bad devices. This application uses low level TCP sockets for maximum performance in real-time. The application is completely written in Swift and maintained by me. I am responsible for all iOS applications for the Emeryville office.
• Manage a group of software developers in Atlanta for Warehouse Automation application and also develop software.
• Manage a group of software and hardware developers in India and also develop firmware for HCSO8 Microcontrollers.

positions.title: Senior iOS Software Engineer
positions.description: Member of the team that develops Expedia's mobile app for iPhone and iPad. Initially 2 other developers and I, implemented the flights module for domestic and international flights. Later we were integrated into the group to develop both flights and hotels.
